K=1 negative-control false-positive rates. The k1-stage0-acceptance-v2 experiment. (A) False
double-well topology in pure noise. (B) False target selection in pure noise. (C) False
double-well topology in single-well data. (D) False target selection in single-well data. Black
points show per-cell false-positive rates by feature count; open points identify incomplete
frozen cells; the red horizontal line marks the frozen 5% maximum. The estimand is the
false-positive fraction among all requested replicates in each control and grid cell, including
failed executions. Rates remain descriptive until every frozen replicate is present and the
complete-cell acceptance rules are applied. Both negative-control false-positive rates must not
exceed 5%. Values are an explicitly fabricated development fixture for visual inspection and
are not acceptance evidence.
